font_metrics_parsed_from_binary.note: Parsed by the hand-rolled SFNT reader in runtime/src/typography/font-metrics.ts from the font files themselves: head.unitsPerEm, OS/2 sCapHeight and usWeightClass, hhea line metrics, hmtx advances, cmap formats 4/12, name table family. Pair kerning intentionally not applied (un-kerned sums are the conservative wider estimate). sha256 values match the MG-006 render-font evidence exactly.
